subject.title: Feature: Activity-based heartbeat with idle timeout

question: What public heartbeat activity/idle contract should OpenClaw support for pausing scheduled heartbeats after user inactivity?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds public configuration and changes scheduler semantics, so automation should not choose the durable product contract or upgrade behavior alone.

options.title: Approve An Activity Idle-Timeout Key
options.body: Add a canonical heartbeat config key that gates scheduled interval heartbeats on recent real user/channel activity while preserving explicit manual and event-backed wakes where appropriate.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Heartbeat Safety
options.body: Defer this issue into a larger heartbeat cost, stale-session, retry/backoff, and spend-safety policy covering related open heartbeat reports.

options.title: Keep Existing Primitives Only
options.body: Decline a new idle-timeout key and rely on activeHours, isolatedSession, lightContext, skipWhenBusy, missing/empty-file behavior, and manual disablement.

recommendation.title: Approve An Activity Idle-Timeout Key
recommendation.body: Add a canonical heartbeat config key that gates scheduled interval heartbeats on recent real user/channel activity while preserving explicit manual and event-backed wakes where appropriate.
